$comment: Mutable run state. The daily build updates cycle/last_run/streak; everything else is configuration you edit by hand.
$model_comment: Tuned for minimum spend. The quality gate is the same either way, so a cheaper model mostly means more skipped days rather than worse merged code. Set flagship to 'opus' once you have measured a week of real usage and know what it costs you.

git_identity.name: Vitej Bari
git_identity.$comment: Numeric id from https://api.github.com/users/vitejbari (the `id` field). The daily build must refuse to commit while this still reads REPLACE_ME.

$paused_comment: Set true to make the daily build exit cleanly without doing work. Cheaper and more reversible than disabling the workflow.
